text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf's student council business has been particularly demanding today. Seeing that she's starting to flag, I encourage her to take a break.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I doubt I am half as tired as you think, but I see your point. There are plenty more meetings to attend come afternoon.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Perhaps forty winks would help steady me for the task ahead.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: …Where am I? I could have sworn I was in the infirmary…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Oh, there are some people over there.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I feel as though I've seen them somewhere before… Wait, could they be… the Three Goddesses?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I've heard they appear in dreams to grant the dreamer's wishes, but I thought it was a frivolous rumor…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Three Goddesses seem to hear Symboli Rudolf's voice. They turn toward her and approach slowly.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hmph. I need no such assistance. I will seize my dreams myself.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: My path is my own. I require no aid to walk it, be it from goddesses or anyone else!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Three Goddesses smile serenely. A bright light fills the surroundings…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: As I thought… It was just a dream.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Still, I feel somehow lighter. Taking a break was a wise choice, it seems.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf comes back at full strength and throws herself into the afternoon's work. Her nap seems to have paid dividends.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Three Goddesses nod sagely. A bright light fills the surroundings…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Well, there's no time like the present. The afternoon's work awaits.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf casts a glance out of the window to find that it's already dark.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: It can't be… Did I oversleep? How embarrassing…
